result.brief: 提出基于扩散 Transformer 的混合专家统一框架，共享动力学专家并复用原子能力专家，统一动作条件世界模型与多种世界-动作模型接口，并配自适应接口路由。
result.reason: Unifies action-conditioned world modeling with world-action models via shared diffusion-Transformer experts, directly addressing video/multimodal world models; robot manipulation evaluation is application-side.
